summary: Tested Keneth Global gallery feature end-to-end (backend + frontend) and did a responsive audit of Home, Shop, Product, Cart, Gallery at 390x844 (mobile) and 768x1024 (tablet). Backend: 5/5 pytest tests pass — /api/gallery returns 28 items (27 image + 1 video), each media file served via /api/static with correct content-type. Frontend: all required data-testid elements present and working — gallery-heading 'The Keneth Gallery', 27 gallery-item-N buttons, gallery-video-play swaps to a <video> with data-testid gallery-video, clicking an image opens gallery-lightbox and Escape closes it; nav-gallery, mobile-nav-gallery (opens via hamburger and routes to /gallery), footer-gallery-link, home-gallery-section with thumbs 0..4 and home-gallery-link all present. Responsive audit: document.scrollWidth equals innerWidth on ALL 5 pages at BOTH breakpoints — i.e. no horizontal document overflow. The elements with right>vw returned by the raw query are all intentional: (a) the top announcement marquee strip inside a parent with class 'overflow-hidden' and (b) the home product carousel inside '.product-carousel-track' with overflow-x:auto (snap-scroll). No unreadable text, cut-off elements, or broken grids were observed in the captured mobile screenshot of the Home page.

issues: body and html have overflow-x: visible. scrollWidth currently == innerWidth on all tested pages, so no overflow occurs today, but adding 'overflow-x: hidden' to body is a cheap defensive guard against future regressions.

action_items: No functional fixes required. Gallery feature and responsive layouts are working as specified. Optional: add 'overflow-x: hidden' on body as a defensive guard.
critical_code_review_comments: Gallery.js mediaUrl() calls src.replace(/^gallery\//, 'gallery/') which is a no-op — can be simplified to `${STATIC_BASE}/${src}`.

Gallery lightbox: clicking the backdrop closes the modal (good) but the prev/next arrow buttons are absolute-positioned siblings of the img inside a flex container with onClick=close on the backdrop; stopPropagation is applied correctly, confirmed working.
GalleryTeaser bakes STATIC_BASE/img.src inline — consistent with Gallery.js's mediaUrl helper; consider sharing one helper to avoid drift.
Backend /api/gallery scans the filesystem per request. Low volume so OK, but a startup cache would be a tiny perf win.
seed_data_creation: None — used the existing 27 images + 1 video already present in /app/backend/static/gallery/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery feature verified green end-to-end. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_gallery.py covers list shape, counts (27 img / 1 video), and content-type for served media. Responsive audit methodology: at each (vw,path) call `document.scrollWidth === innerWidth` as the overflow truth-check, THEN inspect any elements whose getBoundingClientRect().right > innerWidth for a nearest overflow-x: hidden/auto/scroll ancestor — if contained, it is intentional (marquee or snap-scroll carousel). On this app, every offender is contained. Mobile hamburger button is matched via aria-label (no dedicated data-testid on the toggle itself — minor nit, not blocking).
